---
title: "Publications"
  
execute:
  echo: false
  message: false
  warning: false
---

```{r setup}
library(googlesheets4)
SHEET_URL <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/11ohYu5XI8AJg5SPGZ9uhTCIbN72xWNtAaBPW6RhuHzY/edit?gid=1621800203#gid=1621800203"

##LOADING IN DATA
gs4_deauth()

pubs <- tryCatch(
  read_sheet(SHEET_URL, skip = 1),
  error = function(e) {
    message("Could not load sheet\n", e$message)
    NULL
  }
)

pubs$year <- as.numeric(pubs$year)

```

# 2026

```{r results='asis', echo=FALSE}
pubs2026 <- subset(pubs, pubs$year == 2026)

if(nrow(pubs2026) != 0){
for (i in 1:(nrow(pubs2026))) {
  row <- pubs2026[i, ]
  
  cat('::: {.info-box}\n\n')
   cat(sprintf('## [%s](%s), %s, %s\n\n',
                row$title, row$url, row$authors, row$year))
    cat('<details>\n')
  cat('<summary>Abstract</summary>\n\n')
  cat(row$abstract, '\n\n')
  cat('</details>\n\n')
  cat(':::\n\n')
}
}
```
